transcript.content: Hello, welcome in. What brings you to see me today?

I came in because I’ve been trying to clean up my image and get into a better routine for some arts board stuff, but it’s made me more tense and down than I expected. I’m still doing the basic things, but I keep letting little things slip—like fair planning notes or design drafts—that I normally care about. Then I feel guilty about it and end up cancelling plans instead of trying to catch up.
About how long have you been feeling this way?
About two months, I think—since I started trying to completely change my routine and how I present myself.
Have you been feeling down or depressed nearly every day for most of the day?
I’m not really sure. I’ve felt more tense and disappointed in myself, but I don’t know if I’d say down most of the day, nearly every day.
Have you noticed a loss of interest or pleasure in doing things you usually enjoy?
I’m not sure I’ve really lost interest in them. I still want to do the things I usually enjoy; I just haven’t been following through as much lately.
Have you noticed physical signs of anxiety, like a racing heart, sweating, shaking, or an upset stomach?
I haven’t really noticed anything like that, no. I just feel tense sometimes.
